verses.original: δὲ ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἀζύμων ἡ λεγομένη Πάσχα Ἤγγιζεν
verses.transliteration: de hē heortē tōn azymōn hē legomenē Pascha Ēngizen
verses.literal: Now the Feast of Unleavened [Bread] - called [the] Passover was approaching

verses.original: καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς ἐζήτουν πῶς τὸ ἀνέλωσιν αὐτόν γὰρ ἐφοβοῦντο τὸν λαόν
verses.transliteration: kai hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis ezētoun pōs to anelōsin auton gar ephobounto ton laon
verses.literal: and the chief priests and - scribes were looking for a way - to put [Jesus] to death . . . for they feared the people

verses.original: δὲ Σατανᾶς Εἰσῆλθεν εἰς Ἰούδαν τὸν καλούμενον Ἰσκαριώτην ὄντα ἀριθμοῦ ἐκ τοῦ τῶν δώδεκα
verses.transliteration: de Satanas Eisēlthen eis Ioudan ton kaloumenon Iskariōtēn onta arithmou ek tou tōn dōdeka
verses.literal: Then Satan entered . . . Judas - - Iscariot who was [one] of the - Twelve

verses.original: καὶ ἀπελθὼν συνελάλησεν τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ στρατηγοῖς τὸ πῶς παραδῷ αὐτόν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai apelthōn synelalēsen tois archiereusin kai stratēgois to pōs paradō auton autois
verses.literal: And [Judas] went to discuss with the chief priests and [temple] officers - how he might betray [Jesus] to them

verses.original: καὶ ἐχάρησαν καὶ συνέθεντο δοῦναι αὐτῷ ἀργύριον
verses.transliteration: kai echarēsan kai synethento dounai autō argyrion
verses.literal: - They were delighted and agreed to give him money

verses.original: καὶ ἐξωμολόγησεν καὶ ἐζήτει εὐκαιρίαν τοῦ παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν αὐτοῖς ἄτερ ὄχλου
verses.transliteration: kai exōmologēsen kai ezētei eukairian tou paradounai auton autois ater ochlou
verses.literal: - [Judas] consented and began to look for [an] opportunity - to betray [Jesus] to them in the absence of [a] crowd

verses.original: δὲ Ἦλθεν ἡ ἡμέρα τῶν ἀζύμων ἐν ᾗ τὸ πάσχα ἔδει θύεσθαι
verses.transliteration: de Ēlthen hē hēmera tōn azymōn en hē to pascha edei thyesthai
verses.literal: Then came the day of Unleavened [Bread] on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed

verses.original: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην εἰπών Πορευθέντες ἑτοιμάσατε ἡμῖν ἵνα φάγωμεν τὸ πάσχα
verses.transliteration: kai apesteilen Petron kai Iōannēn eipōn Poreuthentes hetoimasate hēmin hina phagōmen to pascha
verses.literal: - [Jesus] sent Peter and John saying Go [and] make preparations for us to eat the Passover

verses.original: Ποῦ θέλεις ἑτοιμάσωμεν δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Pou theleis hetoimasōmen de Hoi eipan autō
verses.literal: Where do You want us to prepare [it] - - they asked -

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἰδοὺ ὑμῶν εἰσελθόντων εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἄνθρωπος βαστάζων κεράμιον ὕδατος συναντήσει ὑμῖν ἀκολουθήσατε αὐτῷ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύεται
verses.transliteration: de Ho eipen autois Idou hymōn eiselthontōn eis tēn polin anthrōpos bastazōn keramion hydatos synantēsei hymin akolouthēsate autō eis tēn oikian eis hēn eisporeuetai
verses.literal: - - He answered . . . vvv vvv When you enter . . . the city a man carrying a jug of water will meet you Follow him to the house - - he enters

verses.original: καὶ ἐρεῖτε τῷ οἰκοδεσπότῃ τῆς οἰκίας ὁ Διδάσκαλος Λέγει σοι Ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ κατάλυμα ὅπου φάγω τὸ πάσχα μετὰ μου τῶν μαθητῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ereite tō oikodespotē tēs oikias ho Didaskalos Legei soi Pou estin to katalyma hopou phagō to pascha meta mou tōn mathētōn
verses.literal: and say to the owner of that house The Teacher asks - Where is the guest room where I may eat the Passover with My - disciples

verses.original: κἀκεῖνος δείξει ὑμῖν μέγα ἀνάγαιον ἐστρωμένον ἑτοιμάσατε ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: kakeinos deixei hymin mega anagaion estrōmenon hetoimasate ekei
verses.literal: And he will show you a large upper room already furnished Make preparations there

verses.original: δὲ Ἀπελθόντες εὗρον καθὼς εἰρήκει αὐτοῖς καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα
verses.transliteration: de Apelthontes heuron kathōs eirēkei autois kai hētoimasan to pascha
verses.literal: So they went [and] found [it] just as [Jesus] had told them And they prepared the Passover

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἡ ὥρα ἐγένετο ἀνέπεσεν καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ οἱ ἀπόστολοι
verses.transliteration: Kai hote hē hōra egeneto anepesen kai syn autō hoi apostoloi
verses.literal: - When the hour had come [Jesus] reclined at the table - with His - apostles

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ἐπιθυμίᾳ ἐπεθύμησα φαγεῖν τοῦτο τὸ πάσχα μεθ’ ὑμῶν πρὸ τοῦ με παθεῖν
verses.transliteration: kai eipen pros autous Epithymia epethymēsa phagein touto to pascha meth’ hymōn pro tou me pathein
verses.literal: And He said to them vvv I have eagerly desired to eat this - Passover with you before - My suffering

verses.original: γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ φάγω αὐτὸ ἕως ὅτου πληρωθῇ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar legō hymin hoti ouketi ou mē phagō auto heōs hotou plērōthē en tē basileia tou Theou
verses.literal: For I tell you that vvv vvv vvv I will not eat it again until . . . it is fulfilled in the kingdom - of God

verses.original: Καὶ δεξάμενος ποτήριον εὐχαριστήσας εἶπεν Λάβετε τοῦτο καὶ διαμερίσατε εἰς ἑαυτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai dexamenos potērion eucharistēsas eipen Labete touto kai diamerisate eis heautous
verses.literal: After taking [the] cup [He] gave thanks [and] said Take this and divide [it] among yourselves

verses.original: γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ πίω ἀπὸ τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἕως οὗ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἔλθῃ
verses.transliteration: gar legō hymin hoti ou mē piō apo tou genēmatos tēs ampelou apo tou nyn heōs hou hē basileia tou Theou elthē
verses.literal: For I tell you that vvv vvv I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from - now on until . . . the kingdom - of God comes

verses.original: Καὶ λαβὼν ἄρτον εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων Τοῦτό ἐστιν μου τὸ σῶμά τὸ διδόμενον ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ποιεῖτε τοῦτο εἰς τὴν ἀνάμνησιν ἐμὴν
verses.transliteration: Kai labōn arton eucharistēsas eklasen kai edōken autois legōn Touto estin mou to sōma to didomenon hyper hymōn poieite touto eis tēn anamnēsin emēn
verses.literal: And He took [the] bread gave thanks [and] broke [it] and gave [it] to them saying This is My - body - given for you do this in - remembrance of Me

verses.original: καὶ ὡσαύτως μετὰ τὸ δειπνῆσαι τὸ ποτήριον λέγων Τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἡ καινὴ διαθήκη ἐν μου τῷ αἵματί τὸ ἐκχυννόμενον ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai hōsautōs meta to deipnēsai to potērion legōn Touto to potērion hē kainē diathēkē en mou tō haimati to ekchynnomenon hyper hymōn
verses.literal: - In the same way after . . . supper [He took] the cup saying This - cup [is] the new covenant in My - blood which is poured out for you

verses.original: Πλὴν ἰδοὺ ἡ χεὶρ τοῦ παραδιδόντος με μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης
verses.transliteration: Plēn idou hē cheir tou paradidontos me met’ emou epi tēs trapezēs
verses.literal: vvv Look The hand vvv of My betrayer . . . [is] with Mine on the table

verses.original: ὅτι μὲν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου πορεύεται κατὰ τὸ ὡρισμένον πλὴν οὐαὶ τῷ ἐκείνῳ ἀνθρώπῳ δι’ οὗ παραδίδοται
verses.transliteration: hoti men ho Huios tou anthrōpou poreuetai kata to hōrismenon plēn ouai tō ekeinō anthrōpō di’ hou paradidotai
verses.literal: - Indeed the Son of Man will go as - it has been determined but woe - to that man - who betrays Him

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοὶ ἤρξαντο συζητεῖν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς τὸ τίς ἄρα ἐξ αὐτῶν εἴη ὁ μέλλων πράσσειν τοῦτο
verses.transliteration: Kai autoi ērxanto syzētein pros heautous to tis ara ex autōn eiē ho mellōn prassein touto
verses.literal: Then they began to question among themselves - which - of them was - going to do this

verses.original: δὲ φιλονεικία καὶ Ἐγένετο ἐν αὐτοῖς τὸ τίς αὐτῶν δοκεῖ εἶναι μείζων
verses.transliteration: de philoneikia kai Egeneto en autois to tis autōn dokei einai meizōn
verses.literal: - A dispute also arose among [the disciples] [as to] which of them should be considered . . . [the] greatest

verses.original: δὲ ὁ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οἱ βασιλεῖς τῶν ἐθνῶν κυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἐξουσιάζοντες αὐτῶν καλοῦνται εὐεργέται
verses.transliteration: de ho eipen autois Hoi basileis tōn ethnōn kyrieuousin autōn kai hoi exousiazontes autōn kalountai euergetai
verses.literal: So - [Jesus] declared . . . The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors

verses.original: δὲ ὑμεῖς οὐχ οὕτως ἀλλ’ ὁ μείζων ἐν ὑμῖν γινέσθω ὡς ὁ νεώτερος καὶ ὁ ἡγούμενος ὡς ὁ διακονῶν
verses.transliteration: de hymeis ouch houtōs all’ ho meizōn en hymin ginesthō hōs ho neōteros kai ho hēgoumenos hōs ho diakonōn
verses.literal: But you [shall] not [be] like them Instead the greatest among you should be like the youngest and the [one who] leads like the [one who] serves

verses.original: γὰρ τίς μείζων ὁ ἀνακείμενος ἢ ὁ διακονῶν οὐχὶ ὁ ἀνακείμενος δὲ ἐγὼ εἰμι ἐν ὑμῶν μέσῳ ὡς ὁ διακονῶν
verses.transliteration: gar tis meizōn ho anakeimenos ē ho diakonōn ouchi ho anakeimenos de egō eimi en hymōn mesō hōs ho diakonōn
verses.literal: For who [is] greater the [one who] reclines at the table or the [one who] serves [Is it] not the [one who] reclines But I am vvv vvv among you as [one who] serves

verses.original: δέ Ὑμεῖς ἐστε οἱ διαμεμενηκότες μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐν μου τοῖς πειρασμοῖς
verses.transliteration: de Hymeis este hoi diamemenēkotes met’ emou en mou tois peirasmois
verses.literal: - You are the ones who have stood by Me in My - trials

verses.original: κἀγὼ διατίθεμαι ὑμῖν βασιλείαν καθὼς μου ὁ Πατήρ διέθετό μοι
verses.transliteration: kagō diatithemai hymin basileian kathōs mou ho Patēr dietheto moi
verses.literal: And I bestow on you a kingdom just as My - Father has bestowed [one] on Me

verses.original: ἵνα ἔσθητε καὶ πίνητε ἐπὶ μου τῆς τραπέζης ἐν μου τῇ βασιλείᾳ καὶ καθήσεσθε ἐπὶ θρόνων κρίνοντες τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: hina esthēte kai pinēte epi mou tēs trapezēs en mou tē basileia kai kathēsesthe epi thronōn krinontes tas dōdeka phylas tou Israēl
verses.literal: so that you may eat and drink at My - table in My - kingdom and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel

verses.original: Σίμων Σίμων ἰδοὺ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐξῃτήσατο τοῦ σινιάσαι ὑμᾶς ὡς τὸν σῖτον
verses.transliteration: Simōn Simōn idou ho Satanas exētēsato tou siniasai hymas hōs ton siton
verses.literal: Simon Simon - - Satan has asked - to sift all of you like - wheat

verses.original: δὲ ἐγὼ ἐδεήθην περὶ σοῦ ἵνα σου ἡ πίστις μὴ ἐκλίπῃ καὶ ποτε σύ ἐπιστρέψας στήρισον σου τοὺς ἀδελφούς
verses.transliteration: de egō edeēthēn peri sou hina sou hē pistis mē eklipē kai pote sy epistrepsas stērison sou tous adelphous
verses.literal: But I have prayed for you, [ Simon ] that your - faith vvv will not fail And when you have turned back strengthen your - brothers

verses.original: Κύριε δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτῷ εἰμι ἕτοιμός πορεύεσθαι μετὰ σοῦ καὶ εἰς φυλακὴν καὶ εἰς θάνατον
verses.transliteration: Kyrie de Ho eipen autō eimi hetoimos poreuesthai meta sou kai eis phylakēn kai eis thanaton
verses.literal: Lord - - said [Peter] - I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν Λέγω σοι Πέτρε ἀλέκτωρ οὐ φωνήσει σήμερον ἕως ἀπαρνήσῃ μὴ τρίς εἰδέναι με
verses.transliteration: de Ho eipen Legō soi Petre alektōr ou phōnēsei sēmeron heōs aparnēsē mē tris eidenai me
verses.literal: But - [Jesus] replied I tell you Peter [the] rooster {will} not crow today until you have denied . . . three times that you know Me

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὅτε ἀπέστειλα ὑμᾶς ἄτερ βαλλαντίου καὶ πήρας καὶ ὑποδημάτων μή ὑστερήσατε τινος Οὐθενός δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois Hote apesteila hymas ater ballantiou kai pēras kai hypodēmatōn mē hysterēsate tinos Outhenos de Hoi eipan
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] asked them When I sent you out . . . without purse [or] bag [or] sandals vvv did you lack anything Nothing - - they answered

verses.original: νῦν Ἀλλὰ δὲ Εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ ἔχων βαλλάντιον ἀράτω καὶ ὁμοίως πήραν καὶ ὁ ἔχων μὴ μάχαιραν πωλησάτω αὐτοῦ τὸ ἱμάτιον καὶ ἀγορασάτω
verses.transliteration: nyn Alla de Eipen autois ho echōn ballantion aratō kai homoiōs pēran kai ho echōn mē machairan pōlēsatō autou to himation kai agorasatō
verses.literal: Now however - He told them the [one] with a purse should take [it] and likewise a bag and the [one] without . . . a sword should sell his - cloak and buy [one]

verses.original: γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι τοῦτο τὸ γεγραμμένον δεῖ τελεσθῆναι ἐν ἐμοί Τό Καὶ ἐλογίσθη μετὰ ἀνόμων καὶ γὰρ τὸ περὶ ἐμοῦ ἔχει τέλος
verses.transliteration: gar legō hymin hoti touto to gegrammenon dei telesthēnai en emoi To Kai elogisthē meta anomōn kai gar to peri emou echei telos
verses.literal: For I tell you that this - Scripture must be fulfilled in Me - And He was numbered with [the] transgressors - For [what is written] about Me is reaching its fulfillment

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν ἰδοὺ Κύριε ὧδε δύο μάχαιραι ἐστιν Ἱκανόν δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: de Hoi eipan idou Kyrie hōde dyo machairai estin Hikanon de Ho eipen autois
verses.literal: So - they said Look Lord here [are] two swords That is enough - - He answered . . .

verses.original: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐπορεύθη κατὰ τὸ ἔθος εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν δὲ οἱ μαθηταί καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai exelthōn eporeuthē kata to ethos eis to oros tōn Elaiōn de hoi mathētai kai ēkolouthēsan autō
verses.literal: - [Jesus] went out . . . as usual . . . . . . to the Mount - of Olives and the disciples - followed Him

verses.original: δὲ γενόμενος ἐπὶ τοῦ τόπου εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Προσεύχεσθε μὴ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς πειρασμόν
verses.transliteration: de genomenos epi tou topou eipen autois Proseuchesthe mē eiselthein eis peirasmon
verses.literal: When He came to the place He told them Pray vvv that you will not enter into temptation

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτὸς ἀπεσπάσθη ὡσεὶ λίθου βολήν ἀπ’ αὐτῶν καὶ θεὶς τὰ γόνατα προσηύχετο
verses.transliteration: Kai autos apespasthē hōsei lithou bolēn ap’ autōn kai theis ta gonata prosēucheto
verses.literal: And He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them [where] He knelt down . . . . . . [and] prayed

verses.original: λέγων Πάτερ εἰ βούλει παρένεγκε τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ πλὴν μὴ μου τὸ θέλημά ἀλλὰ τὸ σὸν γινέσθω
verses.transliteration: legōn Pater ei boulei parenenke touto to potērion ap’ emou plēn mē mou to thelēma alla to son ginesthō
verses.literal: - Father if You are willing take this - cup from Me Yet not My - will but - Yours be done

verses.original: δὲ ἄγγελος ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ Ὤφθη αὐτῷ ἐνισχύων αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de angelos ap’ ouranou Ōphthē autō enischyōn auton
verses.literal: Then an angel from heaven appeared to Him [and] strengthened Him

verses.original: καὶ γενόμενος ἐν ἀγωνίᾳ προσηύχετο ἐκτενέστερον καὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἱδρὼς ἐγένετο ὡσεὶ θρόμβοι αἵματος καταβαίνοντες ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: kai genomenos en agōnia prosēucheto ektenesteron kai autou ho hidrōs egeneto hōsei thromboi haimatos katabainontes epi tēn gēn
verses.literal: And - in [His] anguish He prayed more earnestly and His - sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναστὰς ἀπὸ τῆς προσευχῆς ἐλθὼν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς εὗρεν αὐτοὺς κοιμωμένους ἀπὸ τῆς λύπης
verses.transliteration: Kai anastas apo tēs proseuchēs elthōn pros tous mathētas heuren autous koimōmenous apo tēs lypēs
verses.literal: When [Jesus] rose from - prayer [and] returned to the disciples He found them asleep exhausted from - sorrow

verses.original: Τί καθεύδετε καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἀναστάντες προσεύχεσθε ἵνα μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν
verses.transliteration: Ti katheudete kai eipen autois anastantes proseuchesthe hina mē eiselthēte eis peirasmon
verses.literal: Why are you sleeping - He asked - Get up [and] pray so that vvv you will not enter into temptation

verses.original: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ὄχλος ἰδοὺ προήρχετο αὐτούς καὶ ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα καὶ ἤγγισεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ φιλῆσαι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Eti autou lalountos ochlos idou proērcheto autous kai ho legomenos Ioudas heis tōn dōdeka kai ēngisen tō Iēsou philēsai auton
verses.literal: While He was still speaking a crowd arrived led by . . . - the [man] called Judas one of the Twelve - He approached - Jesus to kiss Him

verses.original: δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἰούδα παραδίδως τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου φιλήματι
verses.transliteration: de Iēsous eipen autō Iouda paradidōs ton Huion tou anthrōpou philēmati
verses.literal: But Jesus asked him Judas are you betraying the Son - of Man with a kiss

verses.original: δὲ οἱ περὶ αὐτὸν Ἰδόντες τὸ ἐσόμενον εἶπαν Κύριε εἰ πατάξομεν ἐν μαχαίρῃ
verses.transliteration: de hoi peri auton Idontes to esomenon eipan Kyrie ei pataxomen en machairē
verses.literal: - Those around [Jesus] saw what was about to happen [and] said Lord vvv should we strike with [our] swords

verses.original: καὶ τις εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐπάταξεν τὸν δοῦλον τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ ἀφεῖλεν αὐτοῦ τὸ δεξιόν τὸ οὖς
verses.transliteration: kai tis heis ex autōn epataxen ton doulon tou archiereōs kai apheilen autou to dexion to ous
verses.literal: And vvv one of them struck the servant of the high priest - cutting off his - right - ear

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Ἐᾶτε ἕως τούτου καὶ ἁψάμενος τοῦ ὠτίου ἰάσατο αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Apokritheis eipen Eate heōs toutou kai hapsamenos tou ōtiou iasato auton
verses.literal: But - Jesus answered . . . No more . . . of this And [He] touched the [man’s] ear [and] healed him

verses.original: δὲ Ἰησοῦς Εἶπεν πρὸς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ στρατηγοὺς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ πρεσβυτέρους τοὺς παραγενομένους ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων Ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν
verses.transliteration: de Iēsous Eipen pros archiereis kai stratēgous tou hierou kai presbyterous tous paragenomenous ep’ auton exēlthate meta machairōn kai xylōn Hōs epi lēstēn
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to [the] chief priests - temple officers . . . . . . and elders who had come for Him Have you come out with swords and clubs as [you would] against an outlaw

verses.original: καθ’ ἡμέραν μου ὄντος μεθ’ ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ οὐκ ἐξετείνατε τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ’ ἐμέ ἀλλ’ αὕτη ἡ ὥρα ἐστὶν ὑμῶν καὶ ἡ ἐξουσία τοῦ σκότους
verses.transliteration: kath’ hēmeran mou ontos meth’ hymōn en tō hierō ouk exeteinate tas cheiras ep’ eme all’ hautē hē hōra estin hymōn kai hē exousia tou skotous
verses.literal: Every day I was with you in the temple [courts] vvv [and] you did not lay a hand on Me But this - hour belongs to you and to the power - of darkness

verses.original: δὲ Συλλαβόντες αὐτὸν ἤγαγον καὶ εἰσήγαγον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως δὲ ὁ Πέτρος ἠκολούθει μακρόθεν
verses.transliteration: de Syllabontes auton ēgagon kai eisēgagon eis tēn oikian tou archiereōs de ho Petros ēkolouthei makrothen
verses.literal: Then they seized [Jesus] led [Him] away and took [Him] into the house of the high priest And - Peter followed at a distance

verses.original: δὲ Περιαψάντων πῦρ ἐν μέσῳ τῆς αὐλῆς καὶ συνκαθισάντων ὁ Πέτρος ἐκάθητο μέσος αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: de Periapsantōn pyr en mesō tēs aulēs kai synkathisantōn ho Petros ekathēto mesos autōn
verses.literal: [When] [those present] had kindled a fire in [the] middle of the courtyard and sat down together - Peter sat down among them

verses.original: δὲ τις παιδίσκη ἰδοῦσα αὐτὸν καθήμενον πρὸς τὸ φῶς καὶ ἀτενίσασα αὐτῷ οὗτος Καὶ ἦν σὺν αὐτῷ εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: de tis paidiskē idousa auton kathēmenon pros to phōs kai atenisasa autō houtos Kai ēn syn autō eipen
verses.literal: - A servant girl saw him seated in the firelight and looked intently at him This [man] also was with Him she said

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἠρνήσατο γύναι Οὐκ οἶδα αὐτόν λέγων
verses.transliteration: de Ho ērnēsato gynai Ouk oida auton legōn
verses.literal: But - [Peter] denied [it] Woman vvv I do not know Him he said

verses.original: Καὶ βραχὺ μετὰ ἕτερος ἰδὼν αὐτὸν ἔφη σὺ Καὶ εἶ ἐξ αὐτῶν δὲ Ὁ Πέτρος ἔφη Ἄνθρωπε εἰμί οὐκ
verses.transliteration: Kai brachy meta heteros idōn auton ephē sy Kai ei ex autōn de Ho Petros ephē Anthrōpe eimi ouk
verses.literal: - A short time later someone else saw him [and] said You also are one of them But - Peter said Man I am not

verses.original: Καὶ ὡσεὶ μιᾶς ὥρας διαστάσης τις ἄλλος διϊσχυρίζετο λέγων Ἐπ’ ἀληθείας οὗτος ἦν καὶ μετ’ αὐτοῦ γὰρ ἐστιν καὶ Γαλιλαῖός
verses.transliteration: Kai hōsei mias hōras diastasēs tis allos diischyrizeto legōn Ep’ alētheias houtos ēn kai met’ autou gar estin kai Galilaios
verses.literal: - About an hour later vvv another [man] insisted - vvv Certainly this [man] was - with Him for he too is . . . a Galilean

verses.original: Ἄνθρωπε οὐκ οἶδα ὃ λέγεις δὲ ὁ Πέτρος Εἶπεν καὶ παραχρῆμα ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν
verses.transliteration: Anthrōpe ouk oida ho legeis de ho Petros Eipen kai parachrēma eti autou lalountos alektōr ephōnēsen
verses.literal: Man vvv I do not know what you are talking about - - Peter replied And immediately while he was still speaking the rooster crowed

verses.original: καὶ ὁ Κύριος στραφεὶς ἐνέβλεψεν τῷ Πέτρῳ καὶ ὁ Πέτρος ὑπεμνήσθη τοῦ λόγου ὡς τοῦ Κυρίου εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὅτι Πρὶν ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι σήμερον ἀπαρνήσῃ με τρίς
verses.transliteration: kai ho Kyrios strapheis eneblepsen tō Petrō kai ho Petros hypemnēsthē tou logou hōs tou Kyriou eipen autō hoti Prin alektora phōnēsai sēmeron aparnēsē me tris
verses.literal: And the Lord turned [and] looked at - Peter Then - Peter remembered the word that the Lord had spoken to him - Before [the] rooster crows today you will deny Me three times

verses.original: καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἔξω ἔκλαυσεν πικρῶς
verses.transliteration: kai exelthōn exō eklausen pikrōs
verses.literal: And he went outside [and] wept bitterly

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ συνέχοντες αὐτὸν ἐνέπαιζον αὐτῷ δέροντες
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi andres hoi synechontes auton enepaizon autō derontes
verses.literal: - The men who were holding [Jesus] began to mock Him [and] beat [Him]

verses.original: καὶ περικαλύψαντες αὐτὸν ἐπηρώτων λέγοντες Προφήτευσον τίς ἐστιν ὁ παίσας σε
verses.transliteration: kai perikalypsantes auton epērōtōn legontes Prophēteuson tis estin ho paisas se
verses.literal: They blindfolded Him [and] kept demanding . . . Prophesy Who vvv vvv hit You

verses.original: καὶ ἔλεγον πολλὰ βλασφημοῦντες ἕτερα εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai elegon polla blasphēmountes hetera eis auton
verses.literal: And they said many {other} blasphemous things against Him

verses.original: Καὶ ὡς ἐγένετο ἡμέρα τὸ πρεσβυτέριον τοῦ λαοῦ τε ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ γραμματεῖς συνήχθη καὶ ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς αὐτῶν τὸ συνέδριον λέγοντες
verses.transliteration: Kai hōs egeneto hēmera to presbyterion tou laou te archiereis kai grammateis synēchthē kai apēgagon auton eis autōn to synedrion legontes
verses.literal: vvv vvv vvv At daybreak the council of the elders of the people both [the] chief priests and scribes met together - They led Jesus into their - Sanhedrin [and] said

verses.original: Εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστός εἰπὸν ἡμῖν δὲ Εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐὰν εἴπω ὑμῖν οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε
verses.transliteration: Ei sy ei ho Christos eipon hēmin de Eipen autois Ean eipō hymin ou mē pisteusēte
verses.literal: If You are the Christ tell us - [Jesus] answered . . . If I tell you vvv vvv you will not believe

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν ἐρωτήσω οὐ μὴ ἀποκριθῆτε
verses.transliteration: de ean erōtēsō ou mē apokrithēte
verses.literal: And if I ask [you] a question vvv vvv you will not answer

verses.original: δὲ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔσται καθήμενος ἐκ δεξιῶν τῆς δυνάμεως τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de apo tou nyn ho Huios tou anthrōpou estai kathēmenos ek dexiōn tēs dynameōs tou Theou
verses.literal: But from - now on the Son - of Man will be seated at [the] right hand of the power - of God

verses.original: δὲ πάντες Εἶπαν εἶ Σὺ οὖν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ δὲ Ὁ ἔφη πρὸς αὐτοὺς Ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι
verses.transliteration: de pantes Eipan ei Sy oun ho Huios tou Theou de Ho ephē pros autous Hymeis legete hoti egō eimi
verses.literal: So vvv they all asked Are You then the Son - of God - - He replied - - You say that I am

verses.original: Τί ἔχομεν χρείαν ἔτι μαρτυρίας δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν ἠκούσαμεν γὰρ αὐτοὶ ἀπὸ αὐτοῦ τοῦ στόματος
verses.transliteration: Ti echomen chreian eti martyrias de Hoi eipan ēkousamen gar autoi apo autou tou stomatos
verses.literal: Why do we need . . . any more testimony - - they declared We have heard [it] for ourselves from His own - lips
